public.articleBody: This is the article body with a very long text content that spans multiple paragraphs and contains various types of content to test the handling of large text fields in the DKG system. The purpose of this test is to ensure that assets with substantial text content are properly published, stored, and retrievable through the normal publish-get-query flow. Additional content is added here to make the string even longer and more representative of real-world use cases where users might publish lengthy documents, articles, or descriptions as part of their knowledge assets.
